source: TaxCalcBench (Column Tax) via Tangle router · run_taxcalc_steered.ts (gpt-5.6 worker, gpt-5.5 auditor)
note: Frontier model. Same 49 TY2024 cases, paired (one gpt-5.6 call vs the same model steered by a firewalled gpt-5.5 auditor). The auditor only corrects errors it can verify by its own computation, so it never regresses a correct line. n=49: helped 4, no-op 45, hurt 0. Paired Δ = +1.8 pts, 95% CI [-0.1, 3.7], t=1.94 — NOT significant. Consistent with the gpt-5.1 run (+0.6, barely significant): steering a raw model is tiny and always safe, never the lever. A strong model already gets most lines right, so an ungrounded critic finds even less to fix.
